title: Quenched Sweet Algerian Potatoes Wrap
description: A rich and indulgent North African dish, featuring tender new potatoes, savory spices, and a tangy mustard sauce served in a crispy ssam wrap.

ingredients.name: Baby new potatoes
ingredients.notes: small, freshly dug potatoes, about 1 inch in diameter

ingredients.name: Harissa
ingredients.notes: North African chili paste, adjust to taste

instructions: Heat 1 tsp ghee or avocado oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the baby new potatoes and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they start to brown and caramelize.
Add the harissa, coriander, cumin, and salt to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the potatoes are tender and the spices are fragrant.
Stir in the mustard sauce and cook for 1 minute, until heated through.
Warm the ssam wrap in the oven or in a dry skillet for a few minutes, until crispy and pliable.
Assemble the wrap by placing a portion of the potatoes in the center, followed by a dollop of the mustard sauce and a sprinkle of chopped parsley.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Cook the potatoes in a preheated oven at 425°F (220°C) for 15-20 minutes, until tender and caramelized.
Alternatively, cook the potatoes on a grill or grill pan over medium heat, turning occasionally, until tender and slightly charred.
